findings.summary: The accepted retention policy does not assign the Exam's mandatory `sanitized-real` originator prompt corpus, its provenance and use-authorization record, generated baselines, failure shrinks, or historical/provider copies to an exact record class, canonical trigger, duration, hold/export rule, and disposition. escalations.reason: LEGAL-G2-R2-001 is an unresolved major Exam-adequacy finding: a mandatory real-originator-derived evaluation corpus has no exact retention and records lifecycle.

The bound Exam and accepted policy contain no record-class mapping or deterministic retention, hold, export, evidence-preservation, and disposition contract for the required sanitized-real corpus and its derivatives.

Resolving LEGAL-G2-R2-001 changes the exact retention policy already accepted through HR-01, so the refreshed policy requires a new current qualified privacy/legal records-owner ruling; this agent cannot amend or accept that policy.
Retention, disclosure, export, and destruction of real-originator-derived prompt records can materially affect originator rights and cannot be left to an unmapped lifecycle or agent waiver.
